recipe.visualDefinition: A minimalist, surrealist composition featuring technical drafting diagrams of characters at the top and a central square frame containing a blue cloud against a halftone sky and a linear perspective horizon.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between technical drafting lines and organic cloud forms
Symmetry in the horizontal distribution of top-row diagrams
Centralized vertical alignment of the primary graphic frame
Juxtaposition of mathematical precision with surrealist imagery
coreInvariants: Off-white or cream paper texture background
Halftone dot pattern in the upper half of the central frame

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A row of five technical diagrams occupies the top 20% of the canvas; a square graphic frame is centered in the remaining space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The blue cloud in the center of the square frame acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the complex technical diagrams at the top down to the central blue cloud, then follow the horizontal perspective lines to the bottom text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive off-white negative space surrounds the central frame, creating a clean, gallery-like aesthetic.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a single pop of mid-value blue; high value contrast between black lines and cream paper.

letterConstructionRules: Top row characters are encased in square drafting grids with geometric construction lines (circles, arcs, diagonals).
Bottom text is a wide-spaced, small-scale serif with high horizontal tracking.
Technical annotations use tiny, fine-line numerals and lowercase letters.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Characters at top are shown as 'in-progress' architectural drawings with visible compass points.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Technical drafting annotations paired with elegant, widely spaced serif display text.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast serif skeleton and classical proportions.
For the technical annotations and grid-based characters.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cream-colored textured paper background. In the center, place a square frame. The top half of the frame contains a blue cloud over a black-and-white halftone dot pattern. The bottom half of the frame contains horizontal lines converging toward a horizon. At the top of the canvas, place five square drafting grids containing geometric construction lines and arcs.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add high-contrast serif characters inside the top drafting grids. Add a single line of widely spaced, small-scale serif text centered just below the main square frame.

verificationChecks: Are the top characters inside visible drafting grids?
Is the cloud blue and the rest of the image monochromatic?
Is there a halftone pattern in the sky area of the central frame?
Is the bottom text extremely wide-spaced?

adjustableVariables: Number of drafting grids at the top
mustRedesign: Specific character identities from the original

mustAchieve: Surrealist isolation of the central frame

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the drafting lines look like architectural tools (compass, ruler).
Check that the halftone dots are distinct and not a solid grey.
Verify the cream background has a subtle paper grain.
Confirm the central frame is perfectly square.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Technical Drafting Grids] + [Surrealist Central Frame] + [Halftone Sky] + [High-Contrast Wide-Spaced Serif] on a [Cream Paper Background].
